PRIVACY / SOURCES / SITE USE

THE
SMALL PRINT.

PAY ATTENTION. is an independent editorial and research microsite by Abhinandan Tejaswi. It is designed to be explored without an account.

What this site collects

The site has no contact form, account system, advertising tracker or configured analytics. It does not set non-essential cookies. Exercise results and page-visible time stay in the current page memory and disappear when you reload or close the page. A receipt is created locally in your browser when you choose to download it.

Ordinary web requests

The hosting service processes the network information needed to deliver the site. Google Fonts supplies the typefaces and may receive ordinary request information such as an IP address, browser information and the requested font files. Source, psychology-reference and LinkedIn links lead to separate websites with their own practices.

Research and interpretation

The Indian Attention Report is a desk-researched editorial synthesis. It is not a representative metro survey, diagnostic tool or universal measure of attention. Each finding includes its population, date, source and limitations. Different findings use different methods and should not be combined into one attention budget.

Images, words and reuse

The photographic scenes are AI-generated illustrations, not documentary evidence or participant records. Original words and design are © 2026 Abhinandan Tejaswi. Linked reports, source data and trademarks remain subject to their owners' terms.

Corrections

Report corrections are recorded in the methodology note on the main page. For a source or accessibility issue, contact Abhinandan Tejaswi on LinkedIn.
